recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20402; future regressions should be addressed in publisher/tooling behavior rather than by changing the terminology mapping source.
issue_request: FHIR-20402 was a Published FHIR-core FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive/auto-approved, asking that value set pages honor many-to-one canonical status mappings from source/status-codes.xml for examples including Condition.verificationStatus unconfirmed/provisional and DiagnosticReport.status partial/preliminary.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-20402-tagged source commit was found. R4 published value set pages still show the reported blank canonical-status cells, while the R5 publication, the issue's applied version, includes canonical mapping columns and generated sc-valueset ConceptMaps for the cited examples.
additional_context: FHIR-19885 is the directly related verification-status alignment issue and is already audited on the combined branch. Its Jira/Zulip trail split the canonical-status display problem into FHIR-20402 after Lloyd McKenzie confirmed that multiple local codes may map to one canonical status. Current source/status-codes.xml retains the cited many-to-one mappings, and Condition, DiagnosticReport, and resource-status are active build inputs. No Confluence reference or conflicting final community decision was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative source mappings exist and the current rendered build exposes them in the value set expansion tables and generated canonical ConceptMap pages, so no core source edit is needed.
